meta.title: SSH client with built-in Tailscale — connect to multiple tailnets at once | Dolgate
meta.description: No Tailscale app needed — the SSH client itself becomes a tailnet node. Connect to several Tailscale and Headscale networks at the same time, without touching OS network settings.
meta.ogTitle: SSH client with built-in Tailscale — multiple tailnets at once
meta.ogDescription: Connect without the Tailscale app, and use several networks at the same time. Headscale works the same way.

keys.ts.h1:
Tailscale built into an SSH client —
connect to multiple tailnets at once
keys.ts.lede: In Dolgate, the app itself becomes a tailnet node. No Tailscale app to install, no VPN profile to approve — reach servers across several Tailscale and Headscale networks from one window.
keys.ts.problem.h2: The Tailscale client joins one network at a time
keys.ts.problem.p1: When your servers are spread across several Tailscale networks, every visit to another network means switching accounts in Tailscale. The moment you switch, sessions on the previous network are gone — and you switch again to go back.
keys.ts.problem.p2: Dolgate uses Tailscale's tsnet to run one node per network inside the app, all at the same time. It is not a system VPN, so there is no reason only one can be on — and no TUN device or administrator rights are needed.
keys.ts.how.s1: Register networks — with an auth key or browser login. For Headscale, add the server address.
keys.ts.how.s2: Pick a network per host — hosts without one connect directly over the regular network.
keys.ts.how.s3: Connect — progress is shown while the node comes up, including when authentication or admin approval is needed.
keys.ts.how.note: Once assigned, everything headed for that host — not just the terminal but SFTP and port forwarding too — travels through the tailnet. Addresses can be MagicDNS short names, FQDNs, or tailnet IPs.
keys.ts.props.i1: Multiple tailnets at once — one node per network, no switching, one window
keys.ts.props.i2: No effect on OS networking — an in-app network stack that never touches system routing or DNS
keys.ts.props.i3: Headscale support — point at your control plane address and register the same way
keys.ts.props.i4: Mobile included — iOS and Android connect the same way, and tailnet settings added on desktop sync over
keys.ts.docs: Registration steps, connection states, and the security rules are covered in detail in the Tailscale guide.
keys.ts.cta.h: Reach the servers inside your Tailscale network right now
keys.ts.cta.p: Windows · macOS · Linux · iOS · Android, open source (MIT)
